  content = '## The Widow''s Legacy

Black Widow finally gave Natasha Romanoff her long-overdue solo film, though it arrived after her sacrifice in Endgame. ## The Legacy

- **Florence Pugh** — Introduced the MCU''s next Black Widow, who became a fan-favorite instantly
- **Red Guardian** — David Harbour created one of the MCU''s most lovable new characters
- **Taskmaster** — Controversial reimagining of the comic book villain
- **The Red Room** — Finally explored Natasha''s traumatic origin in detail
- **Pandemic Release** — First MCU film released simultaneously in theaters and Disney+ Premier Access

## Fun Facts

- Florence Pugh''s Yelena vest pose became an instant meme and cultural moment
- David Harbour gained significant weight for the role, then lost it during filming for the action scenes
- The film was delayed over a year due to COVID-19, originally scheduled for May 2020
- Scarlett Johansson sued Disney over the simultaneous Disney+ release, settling for reportedly $40M+
- The post-credits scene set up Yelena''s appearance in the Hawkeye Disney+ series

## Viewing Context

Black Widow is set between Captain America: Civil War and Avengers: Infinity War, but was released as the **first Phase 4 film**. It provides closure for Natasha''s character and introduces Yelena, who appears in Hawkeye and Thunderbolts*. The Taskmaster reveal connects to the Red Room mythology.',
